title: Empty Pool Studies
description: Five independent empty-pool details that do not share a basin: each image isolates one liminal artifact (drained basin, deep-end ladder, coiled lane rope, vending alcove, return vent) to expand the vocabulary of the theme.
creative_direction: Each image is a standalone study with its own pool environment and props. No shared geometry across images. All use the same 90s direct-flash tonal treatment, grainy consumer snapshot character, and explicit absence of swimmers.
